build.buildCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput

deploy.startCommand: python manage.py migrate --noinput && python manage.py ensure_admin && (python manage.py seed_content --images seed_images || echo 'seed_content falhou; o site sobe mesmo assim') && gunicorn config.wsgi --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT --workers 2 --timeout 60
